checks: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
cd backend && uv run aiact deps check
cd frontend && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm test

gates.reason: the benchmark split must be committed before any engine code that is scored on it exists (CLAUDE.md › Global rules)

isolation.test: cd backend && AIACT_REQUIRE_CORPUS=1 uv run pytest -q tests/test_isolation.py
isolation.design_section: AI Act Classification Assistant — Capstone Init Document.md › Benchmark isolation; CLAUDE.md › Global rules

guardrails.rule: Corpus code never reads eval/ (benchmark isolation); only C2 reads eval/split.json
guardrails.source: CLAUDE.md › Global rules; INIT › Benchmark isolation

guardrails.rule: eval/split.json is committed before anything under backend/aiact/engine/
Held-out Pile B rows are never retrievable by default; only V8's gap run passes include_held_out
No live model calls in CI; live tests are marked @pytest.mark.live
Labels under eval/cases/ are frozen at labels-v1; later changes are logged in eval/LABEL_CHANGES.md
Secrets live only in .env, never committed
Engine stories never see the Commission examples, the Pile B cases or the split; own cases stay readable for replay tests
A long Markdown document (over 20 KB) is never read whole into an agent's context: use backlog.py, the foreman:doc-reader agent, or a search and a range read
Engine prompt and question texts share no 5-word run with a Pile B row (runs that are the Act's own wording excepted) and never paraphrase a Pile B deciding feature
guardrails.note: The check reads denied files, so it runs in the audit, not in Engine-lane worktrees or CI.

guardrails.rule: Frontend data paths: engine work (classification, Q&A, documents) goes through the Python API; the user's own data goes straight to Supabase via supabase-js under the anonymous session and RLS; the browser never holds a service-role key
guardrails.source: INIT › Architecture (UI → FastAPI, UI → DB) and Tech stack › User data; user decision 2026-10-06

post_merge.run: uv run --directory backend python -I -c "import pathlib, psycopg; psycopg.connect('postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres', autocommit=True).execute(pathlib.Path('../supabase/seed/obligations.sql').read_text())" && uv run --directory backend pytest -q tests/db/test_obligations_schema.py
uv run --directory backend aiact evaluate isolation-embed
